newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran reports Kurdish refugees killed.
newsitem.headline: Iran reports Kurdish refugees killed.

text.p: Three Kurdish children and another refugee were killed on Wednesday when the Iraqi army and Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) forces shelled a refugee camp on the Iranian border, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported.
The KDP denied the report but its rival, the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), said there had been fierce fighting in the area.

"Iraqi Kurdish refugees were killed or wounded in Siranband refugee camp in northwestern Iran on Wednesday by artillery shelling of the joined forces of Iraqi troops and Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP)," IRNA reported.
"The shelling by artillery...against the camp near the border city of Baneh started at noon during which four refugees, three of them children, were killed and 10 others were wounded."
IRNA said the camp was home to some 35,000 Iraqi Kurds who fled recent fighting in northern Iraq between the Iraqi-backed KDP and the PUK which was driven into mountains along the Iranian border.
Dilshad Miran, a KDP official in London, said his group had no connection with the attack.
He said that some armed members of the rival PUK were among the refugees, adding that the attack could have been a fight between PUK guerrillas.
But the PUK's Ankara representative, Shazad Saib, told Reuters that KDP forces had advanced from the village of Penjwin near the Iranian border.
"They bombarded Siranband in which there are thousands of refugees. The PUK was obliged to resist and bitter fighting took place in the area," he said.
He said the KDP's forces retreated, leaving behind 10 bodies, including a local KDP commander, he said.

The Iranian Interior Ministry's crisis centre for refugees could not confirm the IRNA report. The U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) said in Geneva it could not confirm the reports as they had no one in the camps.
Earlier this month, Iraq Kurdish refugees set up camp on the Iranian side of the border after they said KDP forces shot at a crowd of refugees and killed four people.
Local Iranian authorities at the Bashmaq border crossing said four people were killed and 100 wounded in that incident.
